messages:
jess_support: Heads up — customer ACME filed an escalation: batch-rerank results look shifted when they include empty candidate lists for some queries. Scores don't line up with candidates.

ton y_se: ack, can you paste the original request payload (sanitized)?

jess_support: here's a stripped example they sent (shortened):

```json
{\
  \"queries\": [\"how to reset password\", \"billing contact\", \"troubleshooting\"],
  \"candidates_per_query\": [
    [{\"id\":\"c1\",\"text\":\"reset steps\"}],
    [],
    [{\"id\":\"c3\",\"text\":\"diag steps\"}, {\"id\":\"c4\",\"text\":\"more diag\"}]
  ]
}
```

jess_support: They see scores like [0.98] returned but attached to wrong query — e.g. score for c3 applied to the empty slot for query 2.

lee_runtime: interesting. sounds like our flatten+offset logic may be ignoring empty arrays and not emitting a placeholder count.

alex_prod: do we have a request-id from ACME? need logs to correlate.

jess_support: request-id: rQ-0a1b2c3d, timestamp 2024-03-12T14:12:09Z

deploy-bot: deploy 2024.03.10-rc5 rolled to us-west-2 at 2024-03-11T03:02:01Z :package:

lee_runtime: copying logs for rQ-0a1b2c3d — grabbing rerank worker trace.

lee_runtime: log excerpt: `batch_flat_map(): input_count=4, flattened_candidates=4, offsets=[0,1,2]` — offsets length mismatch with queries count.

tony_se: can we repro locally? simple script to post that payload and dump our per-query slice boundaries before scoring.

jess_support: customer gave a small CSV of inputs — attaching below (sanitized):

```
q_idx,query,candidate_ids
0,how to reset password,c1
1,billing contact,
2,troubleshooting,c3|c4
```

alex_prod: I recall a fix for trailing-empty lists in bulk imports a while ago; maybe batch-rerank serialization path didn't get the patch. which code path handled the CSV -> batch rows? ingestion-service v2?

lee_runtime: yes ingestion-service v2 flattens by filtering out empty candidate slots then emits a continuous candidate buffer + per-query lengths. if you filter empties without emitting zero length, the offsets shift.

jess_support: customer reported intermittent behavior — not every batch triggers it.

lee_runtime: that fits: only occurs when some batches contain at least one empty per-query list. other batches with all queries having candidates are fine.

tony_se: repro steps I want: 1) POST payload with mixed empty arrays 2) capture server-side "per_query_counts" before scoring 3) compare returned assignments. I'll run it in staging and paste logs.

jess_support: running now in staging with their request-id substituted: rQ-staging-0001

lee_runtime: while you run, check for any code path that compresses counts into a bitmap or uses non-deterministic iteration order. threading could also reorder if we're not careful with async chunk assembly.

jess_support: staging run result: observed mismatch. pasted minimal trace: 

```
IN: queries=3, per_query_counts=[1,0,2]
FLATTEN STEP -> candidate_buffer=[c1,c3,c4]
OFFSET BUILD -> computed_offsets=[0,1,3]  # expected [0,1,1]?  <-- bug here
SCORES -> scores=[0.98,0.12,0.11]
ASSIGN -> query0->[c1:0.98], query1->[] but got c3:0.12, query2->[c4:0.11]
```

lee_runtime: ok that explains it: computed_offsets should be cumulative counts per query; but index 2 ended up using previous cumulative value + last count instead of current. looks like an off-by-one when we build offsets for empty slots.

alex_prod: any quick mitigation for customer? maybe reject requests with empty candidate arrays with a clear error code until we ship fix?

jess_support: ACME is on a tight timeline and this is causing production mis-ranks. They prefer a quick patch on our side if low risk.

lee_runtime: I'll patch the offset builder to explicitly handle zero-count queries (emit offset equal to previous). small fix, unit test added. will create PR and request hotfix to staging then prod.

tony_se: please include regression test with CSV case and the JSON payload. Also add telemetry to log per_query_counts and offsets for 24h so we can monitor for similar events.

lee_runtime: will do. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ingestion-service/pulls/4287 (WIP)

support-bot: Ticket INC-4521 created and linked to PR 4287. Priority: P1, customer ACME.

jess_support: thanks — I'll notify ACME that we're pushing a fix and temporarily added a filter rule to reject empty-candidates payloads with 400 + helpful message.

alex_prod: follow up — after fix, run backfill on last 24h of ACME traffic to ensure no persisted wrong assignments. coordinate with infra for rate-limited replay.

lee_runtime: understood. will request replay slot.

jess_support: closing loop: ACME acknowledged staging hotfix and agreed to wait for prod deploy.

tony_se: nice triage. will monitor telemetry. :thumbsup:
